source_smoke: 260/260 Python tests passed with bundled Core wheel on PYTHONPATH
installed_wheel_smoke: passed: eitaa-bridge 0.7.0.dev31 + eitaa-core 0.6.0.dev19 imported from an isolated venv
typescript: 13/13 TypeScript/TSX files passed compiler parse/transpile syntax. Full MUI type-check and Vite build are delegated to the Windows acceptance machine because npm dependencies were unavailable in the review container.
vite_production_build: not rebuilt in review container; Windows install must create ui/dist/.material-ui-v1 from the GMI4.2 source
contact_source_contract: Actual Eitaa server contacts are listed, added and removed through Core contacts.getContacts/importContacts/deleteContacts. A persistent local directory remains separate and supports categories, manual/file imports, local snapshots and resolved phone lists.
deduplication_contract: Normalized phone and Eitaa user ID are matched transactionally; duplicate imports update/merge instead of creating a second local contact; category links merge; opt-out and sendable state are preserved.
audience_handoff_contract: Only contacts in selected local categories are queried for the target view. No selected category means zero visible target contacts. A unique preview with exclusions and safety cap is handed to the existing send form; no send starts automatically.
migration_contract: No schema-number change in GMI4.2. Core schema remains 9, content-index schema 2 and contact schema 1.
installer_change_scope: Windows setup forces a fresh Material UI build when the .material-ui-v1 marker is absent. The Electron file chooser stages attachments under runtime/uploads before the backend accepts them.
pytest_environment_note: 260 tests passed in the review environment using the bundled Core wheel on PYTHONPATH.
deferred_issues: Windows full npm type-check/Vite build and visual acceptance of GMI4.2
Server contact person photos for users absent from the dialog catalog require a future Core profile-photo model extension
Message template editor/executor after a separately approved architecture stage
Production multi-account workers after isolated lab approval
DC distribution or account-limit avoidance is intentionally not implemented
Red/unselectable Eitaa message after appending to an existing WordPress post remains deferred
summary: GMI4.2 adds real Eitaa server contacts in the right menu, a simplified persistent local address book with strict category target filtering, optional add-to-Eitaa on manual/file imports, lazy/cached avatars, and a safe quick-send composer under the conversation. Material UI RTL/dark/responsive behavior from GMI4.1 is retained and corrected.
material_ui_contract: MUI ThemeProvider, RTL Emotion cache, responsive Grid/Dialog/Stack/Paper/TextField surfaces and full-screen mobile dialogs are the UI baseline. The virtualized message list remains custom for performance.
legacy_dist_in_bundle: present only for frozen compatibility tests; rejected by installer because .material-ui-v1 is absent
backend_change_scope: Bridge API now exposes real Eitaa contacts and safe quick-send routes; all Eitaa RPCs still use the existing scheduler and single-session Core.
npm_install_script_policy: package.json explicitly reviews electron and esbuild install scripts through allowScripts.
person_avatar_limitation: contacts.getContacts profile photos are not exposed by the current Core User model. A person avatar is fetched when the same user has a valid photo reference in the dialog catalog; otherwise initials are shown.
message_template_scope: Only a disabled UI attachment point and architecture document are included. No template execution, scheduling or automatic send is implemented.
